comment: The pilot tenant create request as the pilot runbook issues it (gremion-tenant create ... --enable <id>): votes, calendar, content, publishing, files, messaging and board (board is served in-process from the kernel tenant database and starts no compose profile). Elections, finance, vault and handover are deliberately absent (elections are held off in the app config). scripts/check-pilot-module-defaults.mjs reads this file (check a).
